description: This file defines the KafkaClient class within the Aws\Kafka namespace, extending AwsClient, and provides method annotations for interacting with AWS Managed Streaming for Kafka services.

classes.name: KafkaClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Managed Streaming for Kafka service, extending the base AWS client.

methods.name: batchAssociateScramSecret
methods.description: Associates SCRAM secrets with a Kafka cluster.

methods.name: createClusterV2
methods.description: Creates a new Kafka cluster with version 2.

methods.name: createConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a new configuration for Kafka clusters.

methods.name: createVpcConnection
methods.description: Creates a VPC connection for Kafka.

methods.name: describeClusterV2
methods.description: Describes a Kafka cluster with version 2.

methods.name: describeClusterOperation
methods.description: Describes an operation on a Kafka cluster.

methods.name: describeClusterOperationV2
methods.description: Describes a cluster operation with version 2.

methods.name: describeConfigurationRevision
methods.description: Describes a specific revision of a Kafka configuration.

methods.name: batchDisassociateScramSecret
methods.description: Disassociates SCRAM secrets from a Kafka cluster.

methods.name: getBootstrapBrokers
methods.description: Retrieves bootstrap broker information for a cluster.

methods.name: listConfigurationRevisions
methods.description: Lists revisions of a Kafka configuration.

methods.name: listNodes
methods.description: Lists nodes within a Kafka cluster.

methods.name: putClusterPolicy
methods.description: Creates or updates a Kafka cluster policy.

methods.name: updateClusterConfiguration
methods.description: Updates the configuration of a cluster.

methods.name: updateClusterKafkaVersion
methods.description: Updates Kafka version for a cluster.
